page.overview:
What is Actuating module?

An actuating module was a modification that could be added to a blaster for 500 credits. Mercenaries, bounty hunters, and others used the modules because it provided extra power to a weapon, although it also increased the weapon's recoil.

In 3 ABY the scoundrel Kay Vess used actuating modules to modify the firing rate and power of her VM-19 heavy blaster pistol.

Actuating modules were first mentioned in the canon continuity in Special Modifications, a roleplaying supplementary sourcebook published by Fantasy Flight Games in 2016. They first appeared as blaster upgrade components in the 2024 Massive Entertainment video game Star Wars Outlaws.

The modules first appeared in the Star Wars Legends continuity in Rescue at Glare Peak, a roleplaying adventure module for Star Wars: Age of Rebellion published by Fantasy Flight Games in 2014.
